pay_detail: Track 1 (private lessons plus group class) $800. Track 2 (group class only) $550. A $50 non-refundable deposit is credited to tuition.
notes: There is also a summer intensive linked from the page. Group class is Tuesdays 8:30 to 9:30 p.m. Eastern.
name: Jacobs Composition Academy (online)
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A 12-week online program for people who write music, of many ages and skill levels. You get private lessons (Track 1) and a weekly group class. It ends with a live play and recording of your new piece by IU student musicians.
who_can_apply: People 14 and older (the page also welcomes adults). Parents of kids under 14 can email musicsp@iu.edu. You do not need an audition or past experience.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 semester: registration and payment close January 11, classes start January 18, concerts April 1 to 16. The page says Spring 2027 registration begins in mid November.
how_to_apply: Complete the online registration form and pay the deposit and tuition. Questions go to musicsp@iu.edu.
